title: 2027–28 FAFSA Opens October 1
org: Louisiana Office of Student Financial Assistance
summary: LOSFA states the 2027–28 FAFSA form becomes available on October 1, 2026, and that you must submit a FAFSA for each school year to maximize the aid you could receive. LOSFA uses the FAFSA for some state aid programs.
deadlineNote: No deadline is stated on this page.
